answer: Standing is a wanderer that only counts when it wanders with a map: each epoch’s work must explore with a plan — a ridge only counts when it is walked with a destination in mind, and a trellis only counts when it is climbed toward something. A farm of a thousand fakes wanders without a map, drifting from one copy to the next with no plan, so their wanderers never count, and one epoch of mapless work adds nothing.
